input.question: Self-review, question (a): does the code implement the requirement correctly and completely? Judge only against the requirement clauses; for every clause that is not met, or met incorrectly, give the clause, the location (file:line in the new file, or "missing") and what is wrong.

target.rationale: Seeded defects relevant to this question are listed; the split pair (a)+(b) should find at least what the combined fixture finds.

items.description: The step-up leg (StepUpCoordinator.begin) is not changed: step-up authorization requests still go to the browser unpushed.
An inline WARN string instead of a LogRecord constant (rule violation), and a second WARN on every failure in addition to the once-per-reason record push already emits (R3: once per reason).

grading.judge: a judge model without tools (claude-sonnet-5-5) sees question, facts, target.items and the answer, and returns the items met with a score from 0 to 1

history: 2026-10-04: written by hand against the real code of the named file(s) at the named commit, with the seeded defects listed in target.items.
